anchors.raw: I'm doing the minimal kettlebell routine that he shares for free, and I want to build, I want to use that as a springboard
anchors.note: The prospect is already getting perceived value from the founder's free programming and framed it as sufficient for now. Nobody differentiated the paid programme from the free protocol.

anchors.raw: So I've been going through that year-long program, and they did a head-to-toe analysis at the beginning of it
anchors.competitor: Head to Toe Healing (Dr. Kevin Reese)
anchors.note: A year-long paid programme already occupies the postural-correction budget and, in the prospect's mind, the postural-correction job. He reports it is working ('I can see the magnanimous difference they've done in my posture').

anchors.raw: I have six months with the Impact Academy to develop my own things through their platforms and through the curriculum they have
anchors.note: A second six-month commitment, won by scholarship, absorbing both his time and his stated financial runway. He explicitly sequenced Primal after it.

anchors.raw: He inspired me on such a deep level, man. And just watching him and his forms and just, you know, the inspiration, like real brotherhood feeling I received from his videos
anchors.note: Strong pre-existing affinity for Trevor and the modality; he already bought kettlebells, clubs and macebells. Willingness to spend on the category exists — the constraint is liquidity and sequencing, not belief.

unmet_demand.want: A progression that loads a structurally weak left side without triggering another setback, integrated with the posture-alignment work he is already doing
unmet_demand.why_unmet: Nobody addressed it. The rep never described how the programme handles unilateral imbalance, existing shoulder injury or coordination with an outside postural therapist.

unmet_demand.want: Something he can start now and pay for once a new income stream lands in 3-6 months
unmet_demand.why_unmet: No payment plan, deposit or deferred-start option was mentioned, even though the playbook allows breaking payment up.
